snippet.title: Official Trailer Cure For Death
snippet.description:
🎮 Cure For Death — офіційний трейлер / Official Trailer

This is our first major project — made with passion, sleepless nights, and a belief that indie can be true art.

Cure For Death is an atmospheric adventure game about facing the unknown, overcoming fear, and choosing between life and death.
It was created by a small team from Ukraine — with no funding, but a big heart ❤️

🔔 Add to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3648540/Cure_for_Death/

💬 Let us know what you think in the comments — your feedback means the world to us!
🔁 Share this video to support Ukrainian indie development!

#indiegame #CureForDeath #gametrailer #ukrgame #українськіігри #індігра #u4p
